citations.claim: pole exceeded upright limit at first violating step 43 with theta 0.86 rad
energy grew to ~37.5J via controller work showing instability not initial energy
two steps before failure pole already at 0.71 rad and diverging
three steps before failure pole at 0.44 rad with large cart velocity showing growing oscillation

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.0152448 to 0.0, keeping all other fields identical; removes noisy angle feedback driving instability

explanation: Seeded sensor noise (0.0152) corrupts pole-angle feedback, causing the state-feedback controller to apply large erroneous forces (~39-42N at steps 40-42). This injects ~36J of work, growing oscillation from theta -0.16 at step 20 to 0.44 at step 40 to 0.71 at step 42 to 0.86 at step 43, breaching pole_upright. Removing noise alone prevents failure.
vision_note: The pole tilts increasingly to the right across steps 40 to 42 while the cart remains near the track center. At step 43 the pole is tilted furthest and its tip turns red, marking the upright violation.
